events.title: Various Fixes Made This Week
events.description: Omniscient squashed a bug with the IP login history feature that had gone unnoticed since May, disabled the feature where group owners received email notifications for every new member application via User CP, and fixed the YouTube MyCode tag for embedding videos in posts.

events.title: New Navigation Menu
events.description: A new navigation menu was added at the top of the page after the removal of Omniscient's hamburger menu experiment — another step toward making the forum mobile-friendly.

events.title: Wiki Link Added to Navigation Menu
events.description: A link to the official Hack Forums Wiki has been added to the navigation menu under the Help category — the first signal that the Writers group may make a comeback after its deletion.

events.title: Group rebrands and leadership.
events.description: Harmony was rebranded to Aurora. Lexsern is now a leader of Aurora. Limitless was rebranded to Prosperity, with 00100100 as the owner.

events.title: Posts, prestige, and reputation milestones
events.description: Biggy has reached 1,000 posts; 'Ryan has reached 500 prestige

events.title: Bans
events.description: Neal Caffrey was banned with the reason 'Improve your posting quality and attitude'; Tundrun was banned for leaving an invalid scammer reputation.

events.title: Vacation bans
events.description: Caliban took a 1 week vacation ban; Fortunate took a 1 week vacation ban; Regulus took a 1 week vacation ban.

events.title: Awards
events.description: Jean Paul Sartre received the Flamer award for a post in the HF Theme UI Problems thread; Nòde.js. received the Silver Medal award; ShadyEntry received the Graphic Master award; SrNova received the Fish Err Man award for thread tid=5748569.
